description: Dust in the air (plan 2026-11-17-efectos-sdk, increment F; ADR-047): fine motes that drift with the wind over the streets of the playable core, drawn by the Unity adapter as particles on the SDK's dithered unlit shader. A map whose light preset or facade style is listed gets them by default (map.json "dust": "light" or "off" overrides). Lengths in metres, times in seconds.
